Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • New senders. Email from someone you've never written to, and who hasn't been writing to you for long, gets a New tag. The top of the Inbox shows "3 new senders · Review", which opens View › New Senders. From there you can:

- Allow a sender, which treats them like everyone else from then on;
- Archive their conversations.

  • Optional: hide new senders from the Inbox. Turn this on in Settings › General › Privacy and first-time senders wait in New Senders until you allow them. It's off by default, and nothing is archived or deleted in Gmail.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Warnings for fake senders. A red banner appears when an email:

- claims to be from a company like PayPal, Apple or your bank but comes from somewhere else;
- shows one address in the sender's name but was sent from another;
- couldn't be verified by Gmail.

  • Links that lie. If a link shows one web address but would open a different site, you're asked before it opens.
  • Tracking pixels removed. Hidden images that tell senders when and where you opened their email are now removed, even when you allow images. Messages show "Blocked 2 trackers" when this happens.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Forgot the attachment? If your message mentions an attachment ("I've attached…", "see the PDF") but nothing is attached, Normal Mail asks before sending. Attach File… opens the file picker.
  • Careful with Reply All. You're asked to confirm a Reply All that goes to 10 or more people. You're also warned when you Reply All to a message you only got as a Bcc, since everyone would see you were sent a copy.
